name: Rosal de la Frontera (Spain)
description: Quartered yellow and green with a red cross throughout, its vertical arm charged with a white pale, and the crowned municipal arms of Rosal de la Frontera at the centre (roses on yellow above a wall).
history: Municipal flag of Rosal de la Frontera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cross throughout with a white stripe along its vertical arm
